listing.name: MX vs. ATV Alive — MX vs. ATV Alive — Native Windows Recompilation (gw1337x)
listing.summary: The project reports working Short Track and Free Ride modes with partial single-player support. A 2K crash once damaged a save; keep a separate backup. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own MX vs. ATV Alive Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 5451087B.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build SDK/generated code/Windows runtime from own MXvsATVAlive disc files.
